bullets.text: Minister Dr. R. Kumar personally inspected rain-water removal operations in Velachery.
Polimer News covered heavy flooding in Velachery where 20 motors were deployed for drainage.
Velachery residents demanded a permanent scientifically-validated flood mitigation plan instead of relying only on emergency pumping.
Velachery and other Chennai neighbourhoods faced severe waterlogging following heavy intermittent rainfall since Tuesday night.
Blocked drains with two feet of accumulated waste caused severe flooding near the Velachery Vijayanagar junction.
Heavy rain flooded the Taramani main road like a pond, causing severe distress to motorists and traffic jams.
Greater Chennai Corporation commissioner Sameeran reported that 220 special relief camps were ready and 1,212 complaints were received regarding rain damages.
Heavy rains in Ponneri and Minjur led to rainwater flooding residential areas near railway overbridges.
MLA S. Vijayakumar inspected flood prevention works and drainage clearance in and around Gummidipoondi.
Prompt action was taken in Gummidipoondi to deploy motor pumps following media reports of stagnant rainwater.
Vultr and AMD are expanding AI infrastructure by deploying AMD Instinct GPUs in a new 20 MW supercluster in Chennai.
Tamil Nadu started IT procurement through ELCOT for the third phase of the national e-Courts paperless project.
MeitY directed Meta to review its content recommendation algorithms on Facebook and Instagram to check misleading content.
Farmers' association members staged road roko protests in five places across Thiruvallur demanding full cooperative crop loan waivers.
Reports emerged alleging massive bribes taken from foreign companies during approvals for factories and data centres.
Chief Minister Vijay launched an awareness campaign highlighting the crucial importance of rainwater harvesting.
